_note: Explicit crisis phrase backstop. Deterministic, local, runs before any model call. Deliberately over-inclusive: negations ("I'm not going to kill myself") still route to human help. Matching is on normalised text (lowercase, apostrophes removed, punctuation -> space, whitespace collapsed). Reviewed by the Still team; not exhaustive — the classifier can also escalate, but can never de-escalate a phrase hit.
